record.body: Repair: aff close-batch trusts check-run fields the agent copies into the close request and never reads the store. A request with made-up check_run_id and red_check_run_id, red_result fail, red_runner aff and red_revision equal to the green revision closes a tdd task done (reproduced against affidavit/close_batch.py on 2026-10-16). Fix: resolve check_run_id and red_check_run_id from the store and refuse unless both exist and match criterion_id, runner, result and revision. Also restore refusal of a tdd entry that carries revision without red fields. Found by spikes/differential and spikes/llm-mutants.
record.subject: close-batch-store-verify
